programme.title: Ladykracher
programme.desc: Als ob der Job im Freizeitpark nicht schon anstrengend genug wäre: ohne das Maskottchen-Kostüm wird es allerdings nicht leichter. Außerdem zeigt Anke, was es bedeutet Opfer des Trickfickers zu werden oder wie Onka eine Yogastunde leitet.

programme.title: Ladykracher
programme.desc: Bonuspunkte an der Kasse kann doch keiner mehr sehen – Koi-Karpfen sind dagegen der letzte Schrei! Das kann man von einer Darmspiegelung nicht gerade sagen, aber der gemeine Arschkriecher muss ja irgendwie wieder raus.

programme.title: Ladykracher
programme.desc: Kinderschminken kann aber auch einfach unheimlich echt wirken – Vorsicht ist angesagt! Sensible Küchengeräte wiederum sollte man nicht mit Horrorfilmen verschrecken. Diese und weitere Weisheiten gibt’s bei Ladykracher.

programme.title: Ladykracher
programme.desc: „Haben Sie mal einen Moment Zeit“? Diese Frage ist meist nur der Anfang vom Ende – erst recht bei Ladykracher! Da kann auch mal ein Badenazi genauer unter die Lupe genommen werden und ein Mann schwanger sein. Verrückt? Ja, das ist Ladykracher!

programme.title: Ladykracher
programme.desc: Egal ob als naive Ulla, magische Mutter oder männerfressende Onka – Anke weiß immer zu überzeugen. In dieser Episode ist sie unter anderem in einer Änderungs-Cafeteria unterwegs oder aber tritt ihrem Chef als Geist gegenüber.

programme.title: Ladykracher
programme.desc: So manch Hundebesitzer schafft es nicht den Kot seines Hundes zu entsorgen. Anke hat da ihre ganz eigene Methode den Gehweg sauber zu halten. Aber hat sie da vielleicht etwas falsch verstanden?!

programme.title: Ladykracher
programme.desc: Beim Cash Call Gewinnspiel der lokalen Radiosender kann sich selbst die Polizei nicht zurück halten. Deswegen muss die Leitung möglichst schnell wieder frei für den nächsten wichtigen Gewinn-Anruf sein.

programme.title: Ladykracher
programme.desc: In Zeiten der globalen Erwärmung sollte man sich auch beim Kopieren Gedanken um die Umwelt machen und möglichst wenig Papier verschwenden – Auch wenn es um Kopien der eigenen Geschlechtsteile geht.

programme.title: Ladykracher
programme.desc: Ob "Beziehungen", "Castingbits" oder "Nackt" - bei dem großen Ladykracher-Special gibt es das große A-Z zu Deutschlands beliebtester Sketchcomedy. Dabei gibt es ein Wiedersehen mit Onka, Ulla, Flo und co, sowei die lustigsten Highlights aus der aktuellen fünften Staffel. Das sollte man auf keinen Fall verpassen.

programme.title: Ladykracher
programme.desc: Heike und ihr Sohn steuern ein Boot auf dem Wasser mit der Fernbedienung – oder ist es doch der Vater in der Familie, der da ferngesteuert wird? Außerdem gibt ab jetzt Kim Jong Il seine Meinung zu Gott und der Welt ab. Das klingt doch stark nach den langersehnten neuen Folgen von Ladykracher!

programme.title: Ladykracher
programme.desc: Frau Dr. Schlüter-Monheim hat einen Auftrag: Sie ist von der Märchenwald AG mit der Prozessoptimierung betraut worden. Das bedeutet: der Prinz kann auf keine Fall Dornröschen wachküssen, Hans-im-Glück muss dringend befördert werden, das tapfere Schneiderlein soll wegen Verstoßes gegen den Tierschutz abgemahnt werden. Und der Froschkönig kriegt vielleicht doch einfach einen Kuss?

programme.title: Ladykracher
programme.desc: Pärchenabend in einer Designer-Wohnung. Die Gastgeber geben sich alle Mühe, einen gemütlichen Abend mit ihren Gästen zu zelebrieren. Einzig die Designer-Stühle stören ein wenig …! Neu in der Ladykracher-Familie in der sechsten Staffel: der koreanische Diktator Kim Jong Il – lakonisch portraitiert von Anke Engelke.

programme.title: Ladykracher
programme.desc: Maja und Rainer sind gemeinsam in der Bahn unterwegs als Majas Handy klingelt und der Anrufer von ihr Telefonsex verlangt. Rainer ist empört. Maja bleibt freundlich und versucht zu helfen.

programme.title: Ladykracher
programme.desc: Richard Wildfeuer möchte 200 Euro bei seiner Bank abheben. Fräulein Klinger weist höflich auf die Turbulenzen an den internationalen Finanzmärkten hin, aber Herr Wildfeuer besteht auf die Auszahlung. Schließlich einigt man sich darauf, dass die Kollegin Frau Birkner zunächst einmal ein bisschen nett zu Herr Wildfeuer ist.

programme.title: Ladykracher
programme.desc: Promi-Luder Onka zeigt ihre Bandidos, Ute freut sich auf den Aufguss in der Sauna und Diktator Kim Young Il macht sich mit Facebook vertraut – „gefällt mir“.

programme.title: Ladykracher
programme.desc: Katja beklagt sich bei ihrer Freundin Nadine über ihre miserable finanzielle Lage als Alleinerziehende. Aber zum Glück hat sie einen lukrativen Nebenjob als „Kindertaxi“, bei dem sie Kinder auf dem Rollbrett ihres Kinderwagens transportiert. Außerdem reklamiert eine unzufriedene Kundin ihren Einkauf in einer Buchhandlung. Die Verkäuferin ist zunächst skeptisch, muss aber nach einem Blick in das Buch zugeben, dass die Geschichte wirr und die Hauptfigur flach ist.

programme.title: Ladykracher
programme.desc: Dr. Hülsmann-Krause liest heute persönlich aus ihren Buch „Reise zur Stille“. Während des absolut lautlosen Vortrags schläft die Autorin schließlich ein. Der Moderator verabschiedet die Gäste der Lesung sacht. Die Zuhörer sind sich einig: Dr. Hülsmann-Krause liest absolut fantastisch.

programme.title: Ladykracher
programme.desc: Zum Anbeißen! Jet-Ski, Boogie-Board oder Kite-Surfen findet Jette einfach nicht trendy genug. Sie braucht richtige Action. Deshalb macht sie mit Mike einen Haifisch-Verleih auf. Währenddessen sucht Promi-Luder Onka noch nach dem passenden Bikini, um mit den angriffslustigen Fischen ins Wasser zu steigen.

programme.title: Ladykracher
programme.desc: „Haben sie eine gültige Ausrede?“ Als gewissenhafte Kontrolleurin stellt Anke Engelke die Schwarzfahrer in der U-Bahn zur Rede: Ein Geschäftsmann fällt unangenehm auf, weil er keine Ausrede parat hat. Weitere Fahrgäste versuchen zu helfen, aber auch mit der Gruppenausrede will es zunächst nicht klappen

programme.title: Ladykracher
programme.desc: Im großen Ladykracher-Spezial gibt es nicht nur die besten Sketche der aktuellen Staffel, die lustigsten Ausschnitte von Onka & Co., sondern auch exklusive Einblicke hinter die Kulissen der preisgekrönten Sketch-Show!

programme.title: Ladykracher
programme.desc: Was tun mit einer offensichtlich erwachsenen Kundin, die unbedingt beweisen will, dass sie volljährig ist und Alkohol kaufen darf.

programme.title: Ladykracher

programme.title: Ladykracher

programme.title: Ladykracher

programme.title: Ladykracher
programme.desc: Ein seltsames Geschäft im Park, eine Paartherapie der besonderen Art, ein Zander macht alles kaputt, Kommissarin Bibabutzemann ermittelt im Fall eines verlorenen Sohns.

programme.title: Ladykracher

programme.title: Ladykracher
programme.desc: Achtung Achtung! Erst lullt sie sie ein, dann teilt sie aus – unverschämt die diese Anke Engelke!

programme.title: Ladykracher
programme.desc: Wie jeder weiß, ist Papier vielseitig einsetzbar: Man kann sich Notizen machen, Flugzeuge daraus basteln, hübsche Grußkarten verzieren … Was wohl die gute Anke mit dem vielen Papier vorhat?

programme.title: Ladykracher
programme.desc: Verhaftet und bald auf der Anklagebank? Straftäterin Anke Engelke und ihre Mittäter müssen sich im Ladykracher-Spezial rechtfertigen!

programme.title: Ladykracher
programme.desc: Die achte Staffel „Ladykracher“ bietet 100 Folgen Kult-Comedy, mit 100 Prozent Anke Engelke und neuen Figuren! Wie Luxuslady Estelle – „Am Wochenende wurde unser Sohn geboren. War sehr emotional, sagt zumindest unsere Leihmutter. Mein Mann und ich konnten leider nicht dabei sein, weil wir Konzertkarten hatten“ – oder die promovierte Katalog-Thaifrau Mae Ying, die von ihrem Karl-Heinz nur „Renate zwei“ genannt wird. Außerdem gibt es ein Wiedersehen mit der ewigen Jungfrau Flo.

programme.title: Ladykracher

programme.title: Wild Sardinia
programme.desc: Sardinia has always been the epitome of pure wilderness, an emerald of volcanic origin in the Mediterranean. 1900 metres of coastline and an infinite maze of offshore islands. But Sardinia also has other facets: green valleys, rugged mountains, murmuring brooks, mysterious ruins and a unique fauna. Just off of Sardinia's coast is an untouched underwater paradise - uniquely beautiful, but also dangerous. Pilot whales, dolphins and mobula rays populate the waters at Capo Testa in the north of the island. In the west, the lagoons of Cabras represent a wild landscape of lakes in which thousands of flamingos live and hunt the red brine shrimps. In addition to the flamingos, grey and purple herons and little egrets breed here. Thousands of bats have found refuge in the craggy mountain world of the Supramonte and Gennargentu, with their countless grottoes and caves. In the sea we can observe the mass mating of sea slugs, and thanks to our camera robots and submersible boats we were able to observe beard worms with luminous red gills, as well as bright yellow tree corals in the area surrounding the hypothermal lava holes.

programme.title: mareTV: Tenerife - The Queen of the Canaries
programme.desc: Tenerife is outstanding among the Canary Islands. If only because of the volcano Pico del Teide, which rises exactly 3.718 meters above sea level and is thus the highest mountain in Spain. But not only scenically Tenerife, the largest of the Canary Islands, stands out...

programme.title: One Year in Norway's Lofoten
programme.sub-title: One Year in Norway's Lofoten: Episode 1
programme.desc: Winter means more than just the beginning of the year for the people of Lofoten: For more than a thousand years, Lofoten has been a hub for cod fishing, with seasons lasting from February to April as huge shoals migrate from the Barents Sea to these waters. During these hectic months, more than 65,000 tons of fish are brought to shore, securing the income for the whole of Lofoten for years to come. Around a quarter of the fish caught ends up on lines to dry upon racks. From a young age, the children from the fishing villages get to earn some pocket money by cutting cod tongues and selling the produce as a delicacy appreciated by the locals.

programme.title: One Year in Norway's Lofoten
programme.sub-title: One Year in Norway's Lofoten: Episode 2
programme.desc: Almost unnoticeably, spring turns into summer. The days become longer and longer, with a never-setting sun. People who have spent their winter and spring working hard can finally enjoy their own nature, even though the temperature is only slightly warmer. Lofoten is sparsely populated, just 24,000 people live here. Unstad is one of its smallest communities with only 15 inhabitants, but despite that, it has become a hotspot for arctic surf and is host to the northern-most surf center in the world. Surfers from all over the globe come to surf in the arctic water.

programme.title: Survival of the Fittest in the Alps
programme.desc: The documentary shows the survival strategies of various animal species in the high mountains of the Alps in winter. Despite freezing temperatures and limited food supply, chamois, red deer and snow hares manage to survive the cold months. Latest research reveals the amazing abilities the animals have developed to adapt to the extreme conditions and also how climate change is altering the behaviour of the alpine inhabitants.

programme.title: Wild Bavaria
programme.desc: The moon disappears behind the horizon and the stage is set for a new day in the Alps of Berchtesgaden.

programme.title: Wild Bavaria
programme.sub-title: Wild Bavaria - In The Shadow of the Watzmann.
programme.desc: Mighty and mysterious, King Watzmann sits above Germany's only alpine national park.

programme.title: Women Above the Clouds
programme.desc: Alaska - the largest and at the same time most sparsely populated state in the USA. Only about 740,000 people live here. Often far away in small villages. Almost every village has its own airstrip. Aircrafts are one of the main means of transport in Alaska. Jamie Klaes is one of the many female pilots in the country.

programme.title: Women Above the Clouds
programme.desc: Aerobatics is the supreme discipline in air sports. Only a few pilots dare to navigate a machine during loops, drops and steep flights because nausea and blackouts due to the strong G-forces can be life-threatening. But flight instructor Jenny Holmenes is not deterred - she wants to prove her skills. Although she is still a beginner, she competes in the "Sportsman" class at the Norwegian Aerobatic Championships.

programme.title: Women Above the Clouds
programme.sub-title: Bush Pilots in the Australian Outback
programme.desc: Living conditions are harsh in the Australian outback, especially in William Creek. Only 17 people live here, and in summer even less - only two. There is a motel, a campsite, a pub and the only petrol station in a radius of hundreds of miles. The young bush pilot Hannah Jane Cash lives and works here.

programme.title: Faroe Islands - A Secret Beauty
programme.desc: The Faroe Islands in the North Atlantic, located in the middle of the Gulf Stream between Scotland and Iceland, are an archipelago of eighteen green volcanic islands where a unique culture has developed over the last thousand years. As direct descendants of the Vikings, the Faroese feel committed to their traditions and hold on to customs, without missing out on the advantages of the modern and globalised world - from archaic hunter and shepherd culture to contemporary art. With the highest birth rate in Europe and the lowest social inequality in the world, the just fifty thousand Faroese are a very special people living on one of the last natural paradises in Europe.

programme.title: Countries People Adventures - Iceland Extreme
programme.desc: In southeastern Iceland, Europe's largest glacier, the gigantic Vatnajökull, covers an area of around 9,000 square kilometers. Beneath it lie the world's most active and dangerous volcanoes. This extreme landscape is as dangerous as it is fascinating: glistening white glacier tongues, lagoons covered with icebergs, bizarre green lava mountains, snow-covered volcanic cones, solidified lava flows and imposing waterfalls overwhelm everyone who gets to see them. In 2008, Icelanders declared the glacier and adjacent areas a national park, the largest in Europe. In this documentary, the team meets people who live, work or do research here: a life with the dangers of fire and ice in the overwhelming landscape of Vatnajökull National Park.

programme.title: Gronland - In the Glare of Ice
programme.desc: Greenland is the largest island in the world and the landmass closest to the North Pole. 80% of the country is covered by a layer of ice up to 3000 meters thick. Most of the inhabitants of the country are spread over the breathtaking landscape of the ice-free west coast. The country is mostly inhabited by Inuit, who have been feeding on what nature has provided them for thousands of years. But the original life is in a state of change. The modernisation of society and man-made global warming threaten the Arctic natural paradise that is so incredibly important for our planet. Through the eyes of locals we get to know the authentic Greenland.

programme.title: World's Most Dangerous Railway Lines
programme.desc: Over 196 bridges and through 55 tunnels, the Bernina Express fights its way from Switzerland to Italy. Powerful forces of nature make the railyway line a dangerous route over the Grisons Alps to this day. The film accompanies the Bernina Express in winter over the highest rail route across the Alps.

programme.title: World's Most Dangerous Railway Lines
programme.desc: The Tanzania-Zambia-Railway (Tazara) is one of Africa's most ambitious infrastructure projects. It connects the inland with the coast of East Africa and meant independence from the surrounding apartheid-ruled countries of East Africa. The film accompanies the Tazara on its 52-hour journey through Tanzania and Zambia and uses spectacular aerial shots to show not only the architectural monuments but also the unknown sides of the previously hidden landscapes of Tanzania and Zambia.

programme.title: World's Most Dangerous Railway Lines
programme.desc: The Pamban Railway crosses the tropical landscape of Tamil Nadu, the former Madras, for around 600 kilometers. Heavy storms and rain showers make the route a challenge for Indian Railways to this day. The film accompanies the "Rameswaram Express" over the notorious Pamban Bridge, the first bridge across the Indian Ocean.

programme.title: Dream Islands of Europe: Lanzarote and Fuerteventura
programme.desc: The film presents the two Canary Islands Lanzarote and Fuerteventura. Lanzarote has a rich culture in addition to a volcanic landscape: the film accompanies a ceramic artist, an instrument maker, shows architecture by César Manrique and a camel breeder. On Fuerteventura, in addition to livestock farming and the operation of traditional grain mills, nature conservation plays a major role: islanders are committed to preserving the sand dunes, and there is a turtle hatchery. On Lanzarote, countless volcanic eruptions have formed a bizarre lunar landscape. It is a great challenge for the inhabitants to extract the cultivation of food from the karstic, dry soil. And yet they even manage to produce wine. Protected by thousands of small depressions that act as water reservoirs, they grow vines on porous volcanic rock.

programme.title: The Canary Islands - In the Shadows of the Volcanoes
programme.desc: The Canary Islands were born in the depths of the ocean. Forged by fire and sculpted by winds and waves, this volcanic land offers landscapes of colossal force and almost unreal beauty.

programme.title: Lunenburg: Where the Land Meets the Sea
programme.desc: On the east coast of Canada, a place whose name sounds strangely familiar. The small town of Lunenburg, west of Halifax, was founded in 1753 by North German immigrants. Today, the idyllic town with its many wooden houses is a UNESCO World Heritage Site. In the 19th century, Lunenburg was one of the richest towns in the British Empire, becoming prosperous through fishing and shipbuilding. Glenn Rhodenizer's family traces back ten generations directly to German immigrants. And what the Rhodenizers primarily grow on their fields directly by the sea could hardly be more typical: it is white cabbage, which the farming family processes into sauerkraut. Sauerkraut can be found in every restaurant and supermarket in this area; it is the specialty of the region. The heritage of wooden boat building is successfully maintained by David Westergard. In his ancient shed, he is assembling a 20-meter schooner from four different types of local wood. Building wooden boats, he says, is like "slow food": sustainable, conscious, environmentally friendly, waste-free.

programme.title: Legendary Paddle Steamers
programme.desc: With a length of more than 1000 kilometers, the Elbe is one of the largest rivers in Europe. The river has shaped landscapes since time immemorial: geologically, economically and culturally. One of the most beautiful sections of the river - in Saxony in southeastern Germany - has been navigated by the Saxon Steamship Company since 1836. One of its most beautiful ships is the Diesbar. Its engine is considered the oldest paddle steamer engine still in use in the world, the ship is the only steamer in the fleet still powered by coal.

programme.title: Legendary Paddle Steamers
programme.sub-title: Across the lake Vierwaldstättersee with the “Unterwalden”
programme.desc: Lake Lucerne in the heart of Switzerland stretches from the foothills of the Alps to the first three-thousand-meter peaks of the high mountains. Home waters of the paddle steamer Unterwalden. For two and a half years she was not on the water. Now, after the biggest renovation in her history, the life of the 110-year-old paddle steamer is starting all over again. Her first voyages, with all the imponderables and challenges for the crew, take her into a diverse, wild landscape, right into the mystical heart of Switzerland. In their territory, scenic contrasts collide: barren high moorland and gently rolling alpine meadows, modern tourist resorts and quiet mountain villages, caves hidden deep in the earth and snow-covered two-thousand-meter peaks. The Unterwalden is part of the oldest and largest fleet of paddle steamers so high above the sea. Here on Lake Lucerne, according to national legend, the three original cantons swore eternal allegiance to each other over seven hundred years ago. A land around which countless myths entwine and whose lifeline since the opening of the Gotthard Pass in the thirteenth century was the shipping traffic on the lake.

programme.title: Fuerteventura: The golden beauty of the Canaries
programme.desc: Fuerteventura, the second largest of the Canary Islands, is located just 120 kilometres off the coast of West Africa. The climate is extremely dry and the struggle for water has always been a major setback. Then, around a century ago, returning US emigrants brought what were then modern wind turbine water pumps from the Aermotor Windmill Company with them to Fuerte-ventura. Today, the environmentally friendly and so-called “Chicago’s”, experience a renaissance. Unfortu-nately, original spare parts in good condition are diffi-cult to come by. When Leocadio Araya Sanchez began planting countless cacti on a barren hillside a few years ago, people thought he was mad. His idea was to make a healthy juice drink from the prickly pears – with great success. But getting the fruit to release its pre-cious superfood juice is no simple task. On an almost daily basis, Marcos Tapia is magnetically attracted to one of the paradisiacal beaches of the island. The 44-year-old is Spanish champion and vice world champion in para-body board surfing. When he was 28. Marcos was involved in a serious motorbike accident and has been paraplegic ever since.

programme.title: Wild Pacific - The Beauty of Life
programme.desc: The Pacific Ocean is the largest and deepest of Earth's oceanic divisions. It extends from the Arctic Ocean in the north to the Southern Ocean.

programme.title: Sri Lanka - Tropics, temples and tea plantations
programme.desc: Sri Lanka stands for colourful diversity in all respects. If it's spirituality or Ayurveda you're looking for, here it is. Adventurers and nature lovers can also satisfy their needs here. No one must travel far to discover exotic worlds on this drop-shaped tropical island. "mareTV" delves into the day to day lives of the is-landers, some of whom pursue the most unusual pro-fessions: Uditha Lakmaal is a palm tree climber. He harvests the sap of the trees, known as palm wine, by climbing to the top of them. Sri Lankan stilt fishermen now actually have very little to do with fish and func-tion more as models receiving payment from tourists for acting the part. Anulawathie runs a small floating hoop business, offering car inner tubes for adults and tuk-tuk tubes for children. Different varieties of tea can be found on Herman Gunaratnes tea plantation. Just four carefully selected women are allowed to harvest the exclusive white tea grown there. Each tea leaf is cut individually from the bush by gloved hands and with golden scissors.

programme.sub-title: Over the Islands of Africa, Sao Tome and Principe
programme.desc: Along with photographer Rui Camilo, we travel to the West African island nation of Sao Tomé and Príncipe - in search of images that will capture the soul of this small and beautiful country.

programme.title: Over the Islands of Africa
programme.sub-title: Over the Islands of Africa, Cape Verde
programme.desc: Cape Verde – the islands of Saudade, of longing. For Stéphane and Richard it was a journey full of adventure, unforgettable encounters and magnificent photographs. Director Christian Schidlowski and his team accompanied them on their trip.

programme.title: Secrets of the North Sea
programme.desc: The North Sea is enigmatic. It presents itself in cool shades of grey. Yet who would have guessed that beneath the chilly waves are opulent coral gardens, courting squids, and several of the largest sea creatures on the planet?

programme.desc: Starsky si innamora di Rosey Malone, figlia del gangster che deve incastrare.

programme.title: Starsky & Hutch
programme.sub-title: Long Walk Down A Short Dirt Road
programme.desc: in “Country music“ un dj di una radio di provincia uccide due persone nel tentativo di estorcere $10.000 a un famoso cantante country.

programme.title: Charlie's Angels
programme.desc: Un'anziana e ricca vedova si rivolge agli angeli perche' sono scomparsi alcuni dei suoi preziosissimi gioielli. Inoltre rivela loro che tramite sedute spiritiche, organizzate da una medium, suo marito defunto, le gestisce i suoi affari. Gli angeli stupiti dalla rivelazione, rintracciano madame Dorian (Carole Cook), la medium e organizzano una trappola 'spiritica'.

programme.title: Charlie's Angels
programme.desc: Kelly (Jaclyn Smith), Sabrina (Kate Jackson) e Jill (Farrah Fawcett) vengono incaricate di indagare sulla morte di Karen Jason, una campionessa di pattini a rotelle morta durante una gara. Le ragazze avviano le indagini e Jill, che ha preso il posto della povera Karen, diviene il prossimo bersaglio del crudele omicida.

programme.title: Charlie's Angels
programme.desc: Sabrina (Kate Jackson), Jill (Farrah Fawcett) e Kelly (Jaclyn Smith) vengono incaricate di rintracciare Jericho (Fernando Lamas), un crudele assassino che durante la Seconda Guerra Mondiale faceva parte della Resistenza Francese. Un uomo di questo gruppo viene trovato ucciso e Jericho e' il principale sospettato. Egli intende uccidere anche altri suoi ex compagni e gli angeli devono fermarlo prima che Jericho possa portare a termine i suoi diabolici piani.

programme.title: Charlie's Angels
programme.desc: Il giocatore d'azzardo Roy David (Richard Romanus) e' sospettato di aver rapinato 40.000 dollari a una compagnia di assicurazione. Gli Angeli di Charlie sono incaricate di incastrarlo procurando le prove della sua colpevolezza. Sabrina (Kate Jackson) e Bosley (David Doyle) cominciano con il raggirarlo scomettendo meta' del suo bottino su un cavallo perdente e Jill (Farrah Fawcett) lo ripulisce del tutto sconvolgendo lo schema dei suoi tavoli da gioco. A David, ormai sull'orlo della disperazione, non rimane altro che procurarsi altri soldi.

programme.title: Charlie's Angels
programme.desc: Un importante uomo politico viene rapito e sostituito da un sosia alla vigilia di una conferenza internazionale che si tiene nella localita' turistica dove Jill (Farrah Fawcett), Kelly (Jaclyn Smith) e Sabrina (Kate Jackson) sono in vacanza. Avendo conosciuto il vero uomo politico, Sabrina si accorge della sostituzione. Le tre investigatrici, incuriosite da questa strana faccenda, iniziano ad indagare.

programme.title: Charlie's Angels
programme.desc: Gli angeli di Charlie vengono incaricate di investigare su un caso di incendio doloso ai danni di una nota e rispettabile societa'. Presto scoprono che la compagnia tratta un'attivita' pornografica. Vengono, infatti, ripresi con una videocamera importanti uomini d'affari in compagnia di donne; essi vengono poi ricattati e costretti ad investire nella societa' stessa. Le ragazze devono individuare il cervello dell'organizzazione.

programme.title: Charlie's Angels
programme.desc: Cass Harper (Michael Callan) gestisce un night club a Las Vegas. Egli assume avvenenti e ambiziose ragazze come ballerine; in cambio, pero', le costringe a prostituirsi. Spesso queste ragazze finiscono con lo sposare uomini molto ricchi, abituali frequentatori dei tavoli da gioco del locale. A questo punto, Cass le ricatta minacciando di rivelare ai loro pretendenti il loro passato di prostitute. Una di queste ragazze si rivolge all'agenzia investigativa di Charlie in cerca di aiuto. Per poter incastrare Cass, Kelly (Jaclyn Smith) e Jill (Farrah Fawcett) si fanno assumere come ballerine nel suo locale.

programme.title: Charlie's Angels
programme.desc: Un folle maniaco terrorizza le infermiere di un grande ospedale cittadino; gli Angeli di Charlie vengono incaricate di smascherarlo. Per meglio svolgere le indagini Jill (Farrah Fawcett) e Kelly (Jaclyn Smith) si spacciano per infermiere, Sabrina (Kate Jackson) per una cronista locale in cerca di notizie e Bosley (David Boyle) si fa ricoverare per una finta appendicectomia. Gli Angeli scoprono che un increscioso fatto accaduto tempo prima puo' essere un indizio per la risoluzione del caso.

programme.title: Hot in Cleveland
programme.desc: Als in der Stadt ein Bandwettbewerb stattfindet, gründen die vier Grazien eine Band. Elke spielt Schlagzeug, Melanie Gitarre, Victoria Bass und Joy singt. Doch der verfolgt eigene Pläne und will Joy nur aus einem ganz bestimmten Grund in seiner Band haben.

programme.title: Housebound

programme.title: Mein ziemlich kleiner Freund
programme.desc: Single-Frau Diane verliebt sich in den kleinwüchsigen Alexandre, was in ihrem Umfeld Unverständnis hervorruft. Diane muss sich entscheiden: ihrem Herzen folgen oder sich dem gesellschaftlichen Druck beugen.

programme.title: Extra Ordinary
programme.desc: Besessene Mülltonnen und verfluchter Kies in einer urkomischen, Geister ? Komödie - Fahrlehrerin Rose hat eine besondere Fähigkeit: Sie kann mit Geistern reden. Doch seit ihr Vater bei einem Ritual in ihrer Kindheit gestorben ist, versucht sie diese Gabe zu vergessen. Erst als sie Martin kennenlernt, der von seiner toten Frau heimgesucht wird und dessen Tochter in einer Opferzeremonie dem abgehalfterten Sänger Christian zu einem Comeback verhelfen soll, macht sie wieder von ihrer Fähigkeit Gebrauch. Zwischen Seelen, dunklen Kräften und eigenwilligen Menschen entsteht so ein eigenwilliges Chaos?

programme.title: Sterben für Anfänger
programme.desc: Chaos bricht aus, als ein Mann versucht, ein dunkles Geheimnis über einen kürzlich verstorbenen Patriarchen einer dysfunktionalen englischen Familie aufzudecken.

programme.title: Hot in Cleveland
programme.desc: Joy geht in eine Fruchtbarkeitsklinik, um sich dort künstlich befruchten zu lassen und wählt als Samenspender ausgerechnet Rick aus. Sie schläft sogar mit ihm, erzählt es aber keinem. Auch Melanie kommt Rick näher, als die beiden als Mitglieder der Nachbarschaftswache nachts die Straße beobachten. Victoria will eine Hauptrolle in einem Theaterstück übernehmen, wird aber vom Regisseur abgelehnt.

programme.title: Hot in Cleveland
programme.desc: Die vier Damen hat es in eine Schwulenbar verschlagen, wo sie sich einen ABSF, einen allerbesten schwulen Freund, suchen möchten, der mit ihnen tanzen geht oder sie bei anderen Gelegenheiten begleitet. Ganz so reibungslos läuft aber auch diese Männersuche nicht ab. Elka trifft zudem auf ihre ehemals beste Freundin Lydia, die Chefin der Bar, die einst mit Elkas Mann geschlafen hat.

programme.title: Hot in Cleveland
programme.desc: Victorias Tochter Emmy hat ein Enthüllungsbuch über die Beziehung zu ihrer Mutter geschrieben. Natürlich ist Victoria strikt gegen eine Veröffentlichung des Buches. Das ändert sich allerdings schlagartig, als sie erfährt, dass das Buch verfilmt werden soll. Joy und Melanie sind inzwischen auf einem Blind Date. Was sie nicht wissen: Der 10-Jährige Austin sucht eine Frau für seinen Vater.

programme.title: Hot in Cleveland
programme.desc: Colin und Victoria moderieren gemeinsam eine Sendung im Fernsehen. Colin ist ein Weiberheld und ärgert Victoria am laufenden Band, weshalb sie sich an ihm zu rächen will. Joy soll dabei den Lockvogel spielen. Dumm nur, dass sich Joy in Colin verknallt und der sie auch toll findet. Deshalb will Joy den Spieß umdrehen und die Sache Victoria in die Schuhe schieben.

programme.title: Hot in Cleveland
programme.desc: Kann man wirklich Sex auf Abruf und ohne weitere Verpflichtungen haben? Die vier Grazien gehen der Sache auf den Grund und probieren es aus. Victoria fängt etwas mit dem Rockstar Johnny an und auch Mark und Joy sowie Elka und Fred haben ein loses Ding laufen. Das kommt Melanie zugute, die diese Ergebnisse für ihre Kolumne verwerten kann, die sie für Woman’s Daily schreibt.

programme.title: Hot in Cleveland
programme.desc: Elka schmiedet Hochzeitspläne mit Fred. Obwohl sie nur eine einfache Hochzeit möchte, können die anderen drei sie überreden, eine große Feier zu veranstalten. Fred und Elka suchen Rat bei Reverend Boyce, der gemeinsam mit den drei Grazien die Hochzeit vorbereitet. Zwischendurch kommen bei Fred und auch Elka aber erhebliche Zweifel auf, ob eine Hochzeit wirklich die richtige Entscheidung ist.

programme.title: Hot in Cleveland
programme.desc: Die vier Damen haben eine rauschende Junggesellinnenparty hinter sich und wachen verkatert auf. Alle bis auf Elka haben einen Filmriss, doch nach und nach kehren die Erinnerungen zurück. Fred und Elka warten auf ein Zeichen ihrer verstorbenen Ehepartner, ob diese mit der Heirat einverstanden sind. Als sich die beiden auf dem Friedhof treffen, sind sie bereit, vor den Altar zu treten.

programme.title: Hot in Cleveland
programme.desc: Elka steht zwischen 3 Männern, zwischen Bobby, ihrem totgeglaubten Ehemann, und zwischen Fred und Max. Schließlich entscheidet sie sich für Bobby, der immer noch von der Mafia gesucht wird. Die beiden verstecken sich in einem kleinen Dorf in den Bergen. Als unsere drei Grazien eine besorgniserregende Nachricht erhalten, machen sie sich auf die Suche …

programme.title: Hot in Cleveland
programme.desc: Melanie, Joy und Victoria erzählen Elka bei einem Footballspiel, wie die drei durch das Schicksal in einem Hotel zusammengeführt wurden. Melanie ertappte ihren damaligen Freund in dem Hotel auf frischer Tat beim Fremdgehen, Victoria wollte dort einen Regisseur verführen, um ihre Karriere voranzubringen und Joy wiederum erfuhr in der Hochzeitssuite des Hotels, dass ihr Bräutigam sie sitzen lässt.

programme.title: Hot in Cleveland
programme.desc: Um einen Vortrag zu halten, wird Victoria auf eine Kreuzfahrt für Lesben eingeladen. Begleitet wird sie von Joy, Elka und Melanie, die überraschenderweise an Bord ihre offensichtlich lesbische Schwester trifft. Joy und Victoria, die ein lesbisches Pärchen mimen, verknallen sich prompt beide in den schönen Kapitän. Als sie ihm ihre Heterosexualität gestehen, nimmt das Drama seinen Lauf.

programme.title: Solitary Man
programme.desc: Für Ben Kalmen (Michael Douglas) geht es bergab. Beruflich lief es für den ehemals erfolgreichen Chef einer Autohauskette schon viel besser, privat belastet ihn eine Scheidung. Auch gesundheitlich sieht's nicht gut aus - er hat ein Herzleiden. Das hindert ihn aber nicht daran, so viele Frauen wie möglich ins Bett zu bekommen. Und wenn er damit noch der Karriere helfen kann, umso besser: seine aktuelle Freundin Jordan hat er hauptsächlich deswegen, weil er an der Verbindung zu ihrem Vater interessiert ist. Dann bittet Jordan ihn, ihre 18jährige Tochter Allyson (Allyson Karsch) nach Boston zu fahren...

programme.title: Leben und Lieben in L.A.

programme.title: Please Stand By
programme.desc: Für Wendy ist die Welt kein leichtes Pflaster. Die brillante junge Frau mit ihrem Hang zur Heiterkeit könnte ein unbeschwertes Leben führen ? wäre da nicht ihr Autismus. Für Wendy sind Menschen ein schwer zu entschlüsselndes Rätsel, dabei will auch sie nur ihren Platz in der Welt einnehmen. Eines Tages erfährt sie von einem Drehbuch-Wettbewerb in Hollywood. Ihr Ausbruch aus dem Heim katapultiert sie auf die Reise ihres Lebens, an deren Ende sie ihre 500-seitige Star-Trek- Geschichte für den Wettbewerb einreichen möchte.

programme.title: New York für Anfänger

Doch die neue Karriere hat ihren Preis, denn Annas neue Haare scheinen ihr eigenes mörderisches Ziel zu verfolgen?

programme.title: Super Drama Movie

programme.title: La donna della domenica
programme.desc: Un Classico del cinema italiano, diretto da Luigi Comencini e interpretato da Marcello Mastroianni e Jean-louis Trintignant. A Torino viene misteriosamente ucciso un architetto. Le indagini portano il commissario Santamaria a indirizzare i suoi sospetti su alcuni esponenti dell'alta società, e in particolare su Anna, moglie di un grosso industriale, e sul suo confidente, un dottore.

programme.title: Gli Anni Ruggenti
programme.desc: In questa splendida commedia diretta da Luigi Zampa, l'assicuratore Omero arriva in una cittadina dove tutti stanno aspettando un funzionario fascista. Scambiato per il gerarca tanto atteso, continua a svolgere il suo lavoro. Omero, nel frattempo, si innamora della figlia di un uomo che ricopre un alto ruolo istituzionale, ma l'arrivo del vero gerarca metterà tutto a rischio.

programme.title: Genitori in blue jeans
programme.desc: Una serie di personaggi della Roma bene degli anni '50 frequenta la rinomata sartoria di Peppino, un uomo che ha respinto tutte le proposte di matrimonio che gli sono state fatte negli anni. Durante un viaggio a Parigi, Peppino conosce una donna e finalmente se ne innamora, ma proprio dopo aver deciso di sposarla viene a scoprire qualcosa di inaspettato.

programme.title: Il Mantenuto
programme.desc: Stefano Garbelli, impiegato romano, viene coinvolto dalla prostituta Daniela, che lo indica come suo protettore per difendersi dai magnaccia. Daniela si finge infermiera, suscitando l'interesse di Stefano. Inconsapevolmente, Stefano diventa il suo protettore agli occhi dei rivali e della polizia, che lo convoca al commissariato insieme agli aggressori.

programme.title: Splendori e Miserie di Madame Royale
programme.desc: Alessio, ex ballerino omosessuale, ha solo due consolazioni, la figlia adottiva e i momenti in cui si traveste con sontuosi abiti femminili e si fa chiamare Madame Royale, durante le festicciole con gli amici. Un giorno la figlia finisce nei guai e un losco commissario promette al ballerino di proscioglierla se accetterà di diventare una spia della polizia.

programme.title: Totò, Peppino e la… Malafemmina
programme.desc: Una delle opere più amate del grande Totò che interpreta questo divertente film comico insieme al celebre Peppino De Filippo, il bravissimo Nino Manfredi e la bella Dorian Gray. Totò e Peppino sono due buffi zii di uno studente innamorato di una ballerina. Lei, che non gode di buona fama, si trasferisce a Milano e il ragazzo la segue. Inizia il viaggio degli zii alla volta della Lombardia.

programme.title: I Due Orfanelli
programme.desc: Una spassosa commedia con il celebre Totò. Gaspare e Battista vivono in un collegio di Parigi che accoglie i "figli di nessuno". Quando Il primo scopre di essere il discendente di una nobile e ricca famiglia, parte per cercare i suoi genitori. Quando li trova, si imbatte in una spiacevole sorpresa. Un film di Mario Mattoli

programme.title: Totò, Peppino e le fanatiche
programme.desc: Irresistibile commedia interpretata dal grande Totò, simbolo della comicità, e dal divertentissimo Peppino De Filippo. Il Cavalier Vignarello e il ragionier Caprioli, ricoverati in una clinica per malattie mentali, si rivolgono al Direttore sostenendo di trovarsi lì per equivoco e a causa delle manie dei rispettivi familiari. Riescono a convincerlo e accade qualcosa di incredibile.

programme.title: Bravissimo
programme.desc: Commedia italiana con il celebre Alberto Sordi. Ubaldo è un maestro che insegna al doposcuola del quartiere. Quando il padre di uno dei suoi alunni viene arrestato, Ubaldo scopre che il piccolo a lui affidato dopo l'abbandono dei parenti ha una dote eccezionale: una bella voce che potrebbe renderlo ricco. Ma una felice esibizione televisiva riporta in scena i familiari.

programme.title: Detenuto in attesa di giudizio
programme.desc: Giuseppe è un geometra emigrato in Svezia, dove ha fatto fortuna con la sua piccola impresa edile. Torna in Italia per far conoscere il suo Paese alla moglie Ingrid, ma alla frontiera viene inspiegabilmente fermato e quindi arrestato. In carcere, scopre di essere accusato di un delitto gravissimo. Una delle rare interpretazioni drammatiche del magistrale Alberto Sordi.

programme.title: Racconti Romani
programme.desc: David di Donatello per la miglior regia a Gianni Franciolini grazie a questo Classico interpretato dal celebre Totò, la splendida Silvana Pampanini e il grandissimo Vittorio De Sica. Uscito dal carcere di Regina Coeli, Alvaro riprende il suo ruolo di "leader" del quartiere e coinvolge tre suoi amici in una serie di azioni poco raccomandabili. I quattro furbetti si cacceranno presto nei guai.

programme.title: Vogliamo i colonnelli
programme.desc: Presentato in concorso al Festival di Cannes, questo capolavoro di Monicelli è una brillante commedia satirica interpretata dal grande Ugo Tognazzi. Nell'Italia degli anni Settanta, un deputato di destra, Giuseppe Tritoni, spalleggiato da un gruppo di colonnelli, progetta un golpe. Il Ministro degli Interni, però, viene a conoscenza del piano e ne approfitta.

programme.title: L'arte di arrangiarsi
programme.desc: Il celebre Alberto Sordi in una divertentissima commedia. Rosario Scimoni, detto Sasà, è una persona opportunista e senza scrupoli, nipote del sindaco di Catania, sempre pronto a schierarsi con chiunque possa aiutarlo. Passa dal socialismo al fascismo, cambiando fede politica con la stessa facilità con cui cambia le donne. Prova addirittura a fondare un proprio partito. Diretto da Luigi Zampa.

programme.title: Il Federale
programme.desc: Nel 1944 un graduato delle brigate nere è incaricato di catturare un professore antifascista e di condurlo dall'Abruzzo a Roma. Il viaggio di ritorno si rivela complicato, tra incidenti, bombardamenti, agguati partigiani e incursioni tedesche.

programme.title: Wild Sardinia
programme.desc: Sardinia has always been the epitome of pure wilderness, an emerald of volcanic origin in the Mediterranean. 1900 metres of coastline and an infinite maze of offshore islands. But Sardinia also has other facets: green valleys, rugged mountains, murmuring brooks, mysterious ruins and a unique fauna. Just off of Sardinia's coast is an untouched underwater paradise - uniquely beautiful, but also dangerous. Pilot whales, dolphins and mobula rays populate the waters at Capo Testa in the north of the island. In the west, the lagoons of Cabras represent a wild landscape of lakes in which thousands of flamingos live and hunt the red brine shrimps. In addition to the flamingos, grey and purple herons and little egrets breed here. Thousands of bats have found refuge in the craggy mountain world of the Supramonte and Gennargentu, with their countless grottoes and caves. In the sea we can observe the mass mating of sea slugs, and thanks to our camera robots and submersible boats we were able to observe beard worms with luminous red gills, as well as bright yellow tree corals in the area surrounding the hypothermal lava holes.

programme.title: mareTV: Tenerife - The Queen of the Canaries
programme.desc: Tenerife is outstanding among the Canary Islands. If only because of the volcano Pico del Teide, which rises exactly 3.718 meters above sea level and is thus the highest mountain in Spain. But not only scenically Tenerife, the largest of the Canary Islands, stands out...

programme.title: One Year in Norway's Lofoten
programme.sub-title: One Year in Norway's Lofoten: Episode 1
programme.desc: Winter means more than just the beginning of the year for the people of Lofoten: For more than a thousand years, Lofoten has been a hub for cod fishing, with seasons lasting from February to April as huge shoals migrate from the Barents Sea to these waters. During these hectic months, more than 65,000 tons of fish are brought to shore, securing the income for the whole of Lofoten for years to come. Around a quarter of the fish caught ends up on lines to dry upon racks. From a young age, the children from the fishing villages get to earn some pocket money by cutting cod tongues and selling the produce as a delicacy appreciated by the locals.

programme.title: One Year in Norway's Lofoten
programme.sub-title: One Year in Norway's Lofoten: Episode 2
programme.desc: Almost unnoticeably, spring turns into summer. The days become longer and longer, with a never-setting sun. People who have spent their winter and spring working hard can finally enjoy their own nature, even though the temperature is only slightly warmer. Lofoten is sparsely populated, just 24,000 people live here. Unstad is one of its smallest communities with only 15 inhabitants, but despite that, it has become a hotspot for arctic surf and is host to the northern-most surf center in the world. Surfers from all over the globe come to surf in the arctic water.

programme.title: Survival of the Fittest in the Alps
programme.desc: The documentary shows the survival strategies of various animal species in the high mountains of the Alps in winter. Despite freezing temperatures and limited food supply, chamois, red deer and snow hares manage to survive the cold months. Latest research reveals the amazing abilities the animals have developed to adapt to the extreme conditions and also how climate change is altering the behaviour of the alpine inhabitants.

programme.title: Wild Bavaria
programme.desc: The moon disappears behind the horizon and the stage is set for a new day in the Alps of Berchtesgaden.

programme.title: Wild Bavaria
programme.sub-title: Wild Bavaria - In The Shadow of the Watzmann.
programme.desc: Mighty and mysterious, King Watzmann sits above Germany's only alpine national park.

programme.title: Women Above the Clouds
programme.desc: Alaska - the largest and at the same time most sparsely populated state in the USA. Only about 740,000 people live here. Often far away in small villages. Almost every village has its own airstrip. Aircrafts are one of the main means of transport in Alaska. Jamie Klaes is one of the many female pilots in the country.

programme.title: Women Above the Clouds
programme.desc: Aerobatics is the supreme discipline in air sports. Only a few pilots dare to navigate a machine during loops, drops and steep flights because nausea and blackouts due to the strong G-forces can be life-threatening. But flight instructor Jenny Holmenes is not deterred - she wants to prove her skills. Although she is still a beginner, she competes in the "Sportsman" class at the Norwegian Aerobatic Championships.

programme.title: Women Above the Clouds
programme.sub-title: Bush Pilots in the Australian Outback
programme.desc: Living conditions are harsh in the Australian outback, especially in William Creek. Only 17 people live here, and in summer even less - only two. There is a motel, a campsite, a pub and the only petrol station in a radius of hundreds of miles. The young bush pilot Hannah Jane Cash lives and works here.

programme.title: Faroe Islands - A Secret Beauty
programme.desc: The Faroe Islands in the North Atlantic, located in the middle of the Gulf Stream between Scotland and Iceland, are an archipelago of eighteen green volcanic islands where a unique culture has developed over the last thousand years. As direct descendants of the Vikings, the Faroese feel committed to their traditions and hold on to customs, without missing out on the advantages of the modern and globalised world - from archaic hunter and shepherd culture to contemporary art. With the highest birth rate in Europe and the lowest social inequality in the world, the just fifty thousand Faroese are a very special people living on one of the last natural paradises in Europe.

programme.title: Countries People Adventures - Iceland Extreme
programme.desc: In southeastern Iceland, Europe's largest glacier, the gigantic Vatnajökull, covers an area of around 9,000 square kilometers. Beneath it lie the world's most active and dangerous volcanoes. This extreme landscape is as dangerous as it is fascinating: glistening white glacier tongues, lagoons covered with icebergs, bizarre green lava mountains, snow-covered volcanic cones, solidified lava flows and imposing waterfalls overwhelm everyone who gets to see them. In 2008, Icelanders declared the glacier and adjacent areas a national park, the largest in Europe. In this documentary, the team meets people who live, work or do research here: a life with the dangers of fire and ice in the overwhelming landscape of Vatnajökull National Park.

programme.title: Gronland - In the Glare of Ice
programme.desc: Greenland is the largest island in the world and the landmass closest to the North Pole. 80% of the country is covered by a layer of ice up to 3000 meters thick. Most of the inhabitants of the country are spread over the breathtaking landscape of the ice-free west coast. The country is mostly inhabited by Inuit, who have been feeding on what nature has provided them for thousands of years. But the original life is in a state of change. The modernisation of society and man-made global warming threaten the Arctic natural paradise that is so incredibly important for our planet. Through the eyes of locals we get to know the authentic Greenland.

programme.title: World's Most Dangerous Railway Lines
programme.desc: Over 196 bridges and through 55 tunnels, the Bernina Express fights its way from Switzerland to Italy. Powerful forces of nature make the railyway line a dangerous route over the Grisons Alps to this day. The film accompanies the Bernina Express in winter over the highest rail route across the Alps.

programme.title: World's Most Dangerous Railway Lines
programme.desc: The Tanzania-Zambia-Railway (Tazara) is one of Africa's most ambitious infrastructure projects. It connects the inland with the coast of East Africa and meant independence from the surrounding apartheid-ruled countries of East Africa. The film accompanies the Tazara on its 52-hour journey through Tanzania and Zambia and uses spectacular aerial shots to show not only the architectural monuments but also the unknown sides of the previously hidden landscapes of Tanzania and Zambia.

programme.title: World's Most Dangerous Railway Lines
programme.desc: The Pamban Railway crosses the tropical landscape of Tamil Nadu, the former Madras, for around 600 kilometers. Heavy storms and rain showers make the route a challenge for Indian Railways to this day. The film accompanies the "Rameswaram Express" over the notorious Pamban Bridge, the first bridge across the Indian Ocean.

programme.title: Dream Islands of Europe: Lanzarote and Fuerteventura
programme.desc: The film presents the two Canary Islands Lanzarote and Fuerteventura. Lanzarote has a rich culture in addition to a volcanic landscape: the film accompanies a ceramic artist, an instrument maker, shows architecture by César Manrique and a camel breeder. On Fuerteventura, in addition to livestock farming and the operation of traditional grain mills, nature conservation plays a major role: islanders are committed to preserving the sand dunes, and there is a turtle hatchery. On Lanzarote, countless volcanic eruptions have formed a bizarre lunar landscape. It is a great challenge for the inhabitants to extract the cultivation of food from the karstic, dry soil. And yet they even manage to produce wine. Protected by thousands of small depressions that act as water reservoirs, they grow vines on porous volcanic rock.

programme.title: The Canary Islands - In the Shadows of the Volcanoes
programme.desc: The Canary Islands were born in the depths of the ocean. Forged by fire and sculpted by winds and waves, this volcanic land offers landscapes of colossal force and almost unreal beauty.

programme.title: Lunenburg: Where the Land Meets the Sea
programme.desc: On the east coast of Canada, a place whose name sounds strangely familiar. The small town of Lunenburg, west of Halifax, was founded in 1753 by North German immigrants. Today, the idyllic town with its many wooden houses is a UNESCO World Heritage Site. In the 19th century, Lunenburg was one of the richest towns in the British Empire, becoming prosperous through fishing and shipbuilding. Glenn Rhodenizer's family traces back ten generations directly to German immigrants. And what the Rhodenizers primarily grow on their fields directly by the sea could hardly be more typical: it is white cabbage, which the farming family processes into sauerkraut. Sauerkraut can be found in every restaurant and supermarket in this area; it is the specialty of the region. The heritage of wooden boat building is successfully maintained by David Westergard. In his ancient shed, he is assembling a 20-meter schooner from four different types of local wood. Building wooden boats, he says, is like "slow food": sustainable, conscious, environmentally friendly, waste-free.

programme.title: Legendary Paddle Steamers
programme.desc: With a length of more than 1000 kilometers, the Elbe is one of the largest rivers in Europe. The river has shaped landscapes since time immemorial: geologically, economically and culturally. One of the most beautiful sections of the river - in Saxony in southeastern Germany - has been navigated by the Saxon Steamship Company since 1836. One of its most beautiful ships is the Diesbar. Its engine is considered the oldest paddle steamer engine still in use in the world, the ship is the only steamer in the fleet still powered by coal.

programme.title: Legendary Paddle Steamers
programme.sub-title: Across the lake Vierwaldstättersee with the “Unterwalden”
programme.desc: Lake Lucerne in the heart of Switzerland stretches from the foothills of the Alps to the first three-thousand-meter peaks of the high mountains. Home waters of the paddle steamer Unterwalden. For two and a half years she was not on the water. Now, after the biggest renovation in her history, the life of the 110-year-old paddle steamer is starting all over again. Her first voyages, with all the imponderables and challenges for the crew, take her into a diverse, wild landscape, right into the mystical heart of Switzerland. In their territory, scenic contrasts collide: barren high moorland and gently rolling alpine meadows, modern tourist resorts and quiet mountain villages, caves hidden deep in the earth and snow-covered two-thousand-meter peaks. The Unterwalden is part of the oldest and largest fleet of paddle steamers so high above the sea. Here on Lake Lucerne, according to national legend, the three original cantons swore eternal allegiance to each other over seven hundred years ago. A land around which countless myths entwine and whose lifeline since the opening of the Gotthard Pass in the thirteenth century was the shipping traffic on the lake.

programme.title: Fuerteventura: The golden beauty of the Canaries
programme.desc: Fuerteventura, the second largest of the Canary Islands, is located just 120 kilometres off the coast of West Africa. The climate is extremely dry and the struggle for water has always been a major setback. Then, around a century ago, returning US emigrants brought what were then modern wind turbine water pumps from the Aermotor Windmill Company with them to Fuerte-ventura. Today, the environmentally friendly and so-called “Chicago’s”, experience a renaissance. Unfortu-nately, original spare parts in good condition are diffi-cult to come by. When Leocadio Araya Sanchez began planting countless cacti on a barren hillside a few years ago, people thought he was mad. His idea was to make a healthy juice drink from the prickly pears – with great success. But getting the fruit to release its pre-cious superfood juice is no simple task. On an almost daily basis, Marcos Tapia is magnetically attracted to one of the paradisiacal beaches of the island. The 44-year-old is Spanish champion and vice world champion in para-body board surfing. When he was 28. Marcos was involved in a serious motorbike accident and has been paraplegic ever since.

programme.title: Wild Pacific - The Beauty of Life
programme.desc: The Pacific Ocean is the largest and deepest of Earth's oceanic divisions. It extends from the Arctic Ocean in the north to the Southern Ocean.

programme.title: Sri Lanka - Tropics, temples and tea plantations
programme.desc: Sri Lanka stands for colourful diversity in all respects. If it's spirituality or Ayurveda you're looking for, here it is. Adventurers and nature lovers can also satisfy their needs here. No one must travel far to discover exotic worlds on this drop-shaped tropical island. "mareTV" delves into the day to day lives of the is-landers, some of whom pursue the most unusual pro-fessions: Uditha Lakmaal is a palm tree climber. He harvests the sap of the trees, known as palm wine, by climbing to the top of them. Sri Lankan stilt fishermen now actually have very little to do with fish and func-tion more as models receiving payment from tourists for acting the part. Anulawathie runs a small floating hoop business, offering car inner tubes for adults and tuk-tuk tubes for children. Different varieties of tea can be found on Herman Gunaratnes tea plantation. Just four carefully selected women are allowed to harvest the exclusive white tea grown there. Each tea leaf is cut individually from the bush by gloved hands and with golden scissors.

programme.title: Over the Islands of Africa
programme.sub-title: Over the Islands of Africa, Sao Tome and Principe
programme.desc: Along with photographer Rui Camilo, we travel to the West African island nation of Sao Tomé and Príncipe - in search of images that will capture the soul of this small and beautiful country.

programme.title: Over the Islands of Africa
programme.sub-title: Over the Islands of Africa, Cape Verde
programme.desc: Cape Verde – the islands of Saudade, of longing. For Stéphane and Richard it was a journey full of adventure, unforgettable encounters and magnificent photographs. Director Christian Schidlowski and his team accompanied them on their trip.

programme.title: Secrets of the North Sea
programme.desc: The North Sea is enigmatic. It presents itself in cool shades of grey. Yet who would have guessed that beneath the chilly waves are opulent coral gardens, courting squids, and several of the largest sea creatures on the planet?
