programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Scratch suffers a blow to the head and believes that he is his favorite television character, Edgar Eagle. Sonic uses this to his advantage in preventing another of Robotnik's schemes.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: There is a Sonic Appreciation Day happening where Sonic is the guest in a hotel. However, someone steals his power sneakers and now Sonic and Tails have to find the culprit.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Tails adopts a cute and fuzzy pet named Walter who turns out to be a black hole who sucks up everything in Mobius. Realizing that Walter is from another dimension our heroes have to return him and they soon find themselves spinning through interdimensional limbo.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When Robotnik opens up a resort to make the resident Mobians his slaves, Sonic enlists the help of some robots from an area of Mobius called Scrap Valley.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik creates a robot Sonic suit with the intent of ruining the hedgehog's reputation. He forces a lab rat named Laurence to pilot by threatening his parents.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Dr. Robotnik creates a genius chip so he would have enough brains to rule Mobius, however a computer hacker got hold of it which then the chip landed inside Grounder causing him to be smart.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Sonic leaves Tails in charge of protecting a squirrel village food supply, when he zips off to stop a dam from breaking. Robotnik sends Scratch and Grounder after Tails, who defends himself the best he can with Home Alone booby traps for Scratch and Grounder. When Tails is finally caught, Sonic speeds back to save him.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik introduces the Ultra Freeze-O-Matic, announcing his plan to freeze every citizen on Mobius so that he can install Servitude Chips into the frozen citizens and make them unquestionably obedient. Sonic and Tails must foil the scheme.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When Robotnik invades Labyrinth, an underwater city, and kidnaps Princess Bubbles, a seahorse-dude named Surff seeks Sonic's help. It seems Surff and the Princess are in love, but the royal family deems Surff unworthy. Sonic, Tails and Surff must avoid the undersea traps and Mobius sea monsters while Sonic rescues the Princess and reunites her with Surff -- making it look like Surff did the whole thing.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik reprograms a machine created by Von Schlemmer capable of turning dreams into reality, unleashing a Nightmare Monster upon Mobius.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When S and G rocket to outer space to mine a radioactive mineral from asteroids, Sonic and Tails stow away. Through a blunder by the robots, all are stranded in space, and Robotnik tries to blow all of them out of the stars. Sonic builds a rocket out of S and G's spare parts, and all return to Mobius.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik's attempt to turn Sonic into an old man with his newest device backfires, turning him and Tails, and later himself, into babies. Now stuck in a day-care, the infantile Sonic and Tails must try to keep Robotnik under control, while Scratch and Grounder attempt to get him back.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik plans to block out the sun and extinguish all life and nature on the planet Mobius. Then he creates a robot son and tries to train him in the ways of wickedness. But when Robotnik Jr. meets Sonic, he becomes a naturalist and teams up with Sonic to thwart Robotnik's evil scheme.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik invents an electron altering generator which makes Scratch and Grounder twice as fast as Sonic. When they lose it and Tails picks it up, Tails speeds through the Mobius countryside leaving disasters and accidents in his wake. Seeing this, Robotnik convinces the villagers that the little fox belongs in jail, and Tails is forced to flee. With Tails all alone, Scratch and Grounder attack, and Sonic makes a last minute rescue.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik captures a Kangaroo named MacHopper, and uses his brain-wipe-reprogramming-computer to transform him into a resourceful demolitions expert (Ala MacGiver). But Mac escapes before Robotnik installs the final Get Sonic program, and teams up with Sonic and Tails to BLAST Robotnik.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Sonic joins up with a group of Dr. Robotnik's rejects who have been banished to the dump and helps them understand that their shortcomings were really their strengths.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When S and G rocket to outer space to mine a radioactive mineral from asteroids, Sonic and Tails stow away. Through a blunder by the robots, all are stranded in space, and Robotnik tries to blow all of them out of the stars. Sonic builds a rocket out of S and G's spare parts, and all return to Mobius.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When a Rebel Base is threatened by Robotnik, Sonic and Tails team up with Big Mike and Da Bears to run a booby-trapped gauntlet in their gigantic Road Warrior-like truck, breaking through every obstacle S and G put in their way until they save the rebels.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik pretends to retire, and lures Sonic and Tails into a phony vacation resort, laden with booby-traps set by Scratch and Grounder. But Sonic takes the bungee jumping, hang gliding, and skydiving in stride, and gives the bashes the bots.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik and a rival named Quark Rex try to cooperate in capturing Sonic. However, Sonic tricks them into becoming enemies, and they try to outdo each other.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Coconuts acquires a magic wand and magical gadgets from Wes Weasley (after agreeing to forward all payments to Robotnik), and attempts to master them. Meanwhile, Robotnik tries to change Sonic-themed mobium banknotes into Robotnik banknotes in the Mobius Mint.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.sub-title: Super Special Sonic Search and Smash Squad
programme.desc: When Sonic and Tails are captured by Grounder and Scratch, Sonic tricks them into letting them escape by reminiscing about how they all met. Several badniks seen early on in this episode later resurfaced in Dr. Robotnik's Mean Bean Machine.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: While on pursuit with Scratch and Grounder, Sonic and Tails hide in an underground mine which a miser mole think that they are trespassers.

programme.title: Sonic TV
programme.desc: The Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog 24/7

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Sonic must save a family of sloths from Dr. Robotnik's slow-motion ray, but when he himself is slowed down by Scratch and Grounder, Tails and the sloth family must take action.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Desperate to get workers to build a Robotnik statue, Dr. Robotnik opens Casino Night Zone with his pal Smiley but when Sonic stops Scratch and Grounder, Robotnik traps Tails so Sonic has to make a choice to save his pal.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik imprisons a satirical cartoonist named Sketch Lampoon for making fun of him in his comic book, much to the anger of Sonic, his biggest fan. Sonic purposely allows his own capture as well, but does not expect to be placed in a maximum-security jail cell. With Robotnik angrily sends Sonic in the cell for interfering with his plans once again.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Scratch, Grounder and Coconuts set up a chili-dog trap which then resulted with Tails been captured by a mysterious person so Sonic has to find Tails and for Robotnik and co to capture Sonic.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.sub-title: Close Encounters of the Sonic Kind
programme.desc: While Scratch and Grounder try to catch Sonic using a Suction plate, two aliens, one being a prince, crash lands on Mobius. Sonic meets the prince when he finds out that the prince's baby brother would blow up Mobius which Sonic must save.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik's momma escapes from the home for mothers of villains and demands her birthday present! When she endangers Sonic and Tails, and they manage to have her taken back to the home, even Robotnik is glad to see her go.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Coconuts is exiled by Robotnik to a remote jungle, where he uses a giant baby ape to destroy villages. But Sonic exposes Coconuts as a robot, and the baby ape's real Dad takes Coconuts and the baby ape away for a spanking.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: A country and western singer released a song about Sonic which is making Dr. Robotnik mad and builds a music destroyer robot.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog

programme.desc: Sonic and Tails rescue Lucas, Robotnik's first prisoner, and attempt to reunite him with his girlfriend, Lucinda. However, Robotnik is also in love with Lucinda, and pursues Lucas.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: Red et la Task Force se lancent à la recherche du légendaire fugitif Robert Vesco, l'un des escrocs les plus célèbres de l'histoire.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: Red est envoyé dans un établissement médical fédéral à la suite de sa demande d'évaluation psychiatrique auprès du tribunal. Liz et Jennifer recherche une personne de la Blacklist qui, à leur avis, pourrait détenir de précieuses informations sur le passé de Red.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: Alors que Red et Dembe sollicitent l'aide de Glen pour que le jury soit clément lors du procès de Red, la task force enquête sur une série de morts mystérieuses.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: Alors que Liz et Jennifer recherchent une femme qui pourrait connaître un secret du passé de Red, elles se retrouvent menacées par un dangereux trafiquant. Pendant ce temps, Red joue le rôle de médiateur entre deux gangs rivaux en prison.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: Tandis que Red se bat devant le tribunal pour blanchir son nom une fois pour toutes, Liz et la Task-Force enquêtent sur une personne de la Blacklist qui a la réputation de s'enrichir sur les secrets des autres.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: Red demande à Liz d'enquêter sur une organisation secrète d'assassins, embauchés par des agences de renseignement mondiales afin d'éliminer les anciens agents.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: La Task Force recherche une femme qui a pour spécialité de prendre le contrôle d'organisations criminelles et qui pourrait avoir des informations sur le complot international impliquant la conseillère présidentielle Anna McMahon.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: Liz et Ressler enquêtent sur une personne qui propose d'effacer les dettes de jeu - mais pas à n'importe quel prix. Pendant ce temps, Dembe est de plus en plus inquiet en voyant Red rechercher l'individu qui l'a livré à la police.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: Red et la Task Force se mobilisent pour empêcher un groupe terroriste anticapitaliste d'enlever des enfants. Pendant ce temps, Ressler enquête pour savoir ce qui est arrivé à sa mère, Katarina Rostova, ancienne membre du KGB.

programme.title: The Blacklist

programme.desc: Seule dans un pays étranger après une mission qui a tourné au fiasco, Katarina Rostova cherche à fuir les autorités qui la traquent.

programme.desc: Lorsque plusieurs enfants sont enlevés dans des circonstances similaires, la Task Force met tout en œuvre pour retrouver le ravisseur.

programme.title: Starsky & Hutch
programme.desc: Lorsque des sosies de Starsky et Hutch écument les rues dans une voiture semblable à la leur et terrorisent les gens, l'histoire devient deux fois plus amusante, mais deux fois plus dangereuse. Les vrais Starsky et Hutch peuvent-ils pincer leurs imitateurs avant de se faire retirer leurs badges ?

programme.title: Starsky & Hutch
programme.desc: La nouvelle relation amoureuse de Hutch tourne mal, car la femme est complètement folle.

programme.title: Starsky & Hutch
programme.desc: Dans cet épisode de deux heures, une série de meurtres sur une île de rêve semble être l'œuvre d'un magicien vaudou.

programme.title: Starsky & Hutch
programme.desc: George Prudholm, apparu dans l'épisode "Le paria" de la saison 1, en veut à Starsky. Sa soif de vengeance met en danger la petite amie de Starsky, Terry Roberts, une éducatrice spécialisée.

programme.title: Starsky & Hutch
programme.desc: Un groupe de flis ripous fait la loi en agissant comme juges, jurés et bourreaux de criminels endurcis libérés par un système judiciaire trop souple. Starsky joue un policier mécontent pour s'infiltrer dans ce groupe.

programme.title: Starsky & Hutch
programme.desc: Une couturière costaricaine est assassinée dans le quartier des vêtements, mais un agent de l'immigration cherche à entraver l'enquête de Starsky et Hutch, ce qui ne fait que renforcer leurs soupçons et renforcer leur résolution d'attraper le tueur.

programme.title: Don't Breathe
programme.desc: Pour échapper à la violence de sa mère et sauver sa jeune sœur d'une existence sans avenir, Rocky est prête à tout. Avec ses amis Alex et Money, elle a déjà commis quelques cambriolages, mais rien qui leur rapporte assez pour enfin quitter Détroit. Lorsque le trio entend parler d'un aveugle qui vit en solitaire et garde chez lui une petite fortune, ils préparent ce qu'ils pensent être leur ultime coup. Mais leur victime va se révéler bien plus effrayante, et surtout bien plus dangereuse que ce à quoi ils s'attendaient…

programme.title: Don't Breathe 2
programme.desc: Quelques années après l'effraction mortelle au domicile de Norman Nordstrom (Stephen Lang), ce dernier vit toujours dans la maison délabrée de Détroit mais cette fois avec une adolescente nommée Phoenix.

programme.title: Street Fighter
programme.desc: Le dictateur Bison (Raul Julia) s'est mis en tête de régner sur un quatrième royaume. Afin d'atteindre son but, il prend en otage les émissaires du Conseil de Sécurité et ne leur épargnera la vie qu'en échange de 20 milliards de dollars. Le colonel Guile (Jean-Claude Van Damme) et la séduisante Cammy (Kylie Minogue) ont exactement 72 heures pour arrêter Bison et libérer les otages… © 1994 COLUMBIA TRISTAR FILM DISTRIBUTORS AND CAPCOM CO., LTD. programme.title: Traque Sur Internet
programme.desc: Angela Bennett, une jeune analyste du reseau Internet, va se retrouver malgré elle au coeur d'un réseau de terrorisme informatique.

programme.title: Fenetre Secrete
programme.desc: Écrivain à succès, Morton Rainey (Johnny Depp) s'est retiré dans sa résidence secondaire sur les rives du lac Tashmore. Un beau jour, un homme se présente à sa porte. Il accuse Morton de lui avoir volé son récit. Son nom est John Shooter et il exige réparation. Alors que Morton tente de retrouver le manuscrit original afin de prouver son innocence, Shooter se fait de plus en plus menaçant. © 2004 COLUMBIA PICTURES INDUSTRIES, INC. ALL RIGHTS RESERVED.

programme.title: Panic Room
programme.desc: Meg Altman, la trentaine, a très mal vécu la séparation avec son mari et angoisse à l'idée de devoir élever seule sa fille Sarah. Afin de commencer une nouvelle vie loin de ses craintes, Meg achète une immense et splendide maison située dans un quartier huppé à l'ouest de New York.

programme.title: The Walk
programme.desc: Douze personnes ont marché sur la lune. Un seul homme aura marché au-dessus du vide vertigineux séparant les deux tours du World Trade Center. Le funambule Philippe Petit, avec l'aide de son mentor, Papa Rudy, et d'une bande de passionnés de tous horizons, va surmonter les pires obstacles, vaincre les trahisons, les dissensions, et prendre les risques les plus insensés pour exécuter le plus fou de tous les paris : passer d'une tour à l'autre du World Trade Center en marchant sur un fil tendu au-dessus du vide …

programme.title: L’Affaire Roman J.
programme.desc: Avec la mort de son mentor, Roman J. Israel (Denzel Washington), avocat aussi idéaliste que déterminé, voit sa vie bouleversée. Recruté par l'ambitieux George Pierce (Colin Farrell), Roman se lie d'amitié avec une militante de l'égalité des droits (Carmen Ejogo). Confronté à des événements extrêmes, il va pourtant être obligé de remettre en question l'engagement qui a déterminé toute sa carrière…

programme.title: Anges & Demons
programme.desc: Le pape vient de mourir. Au même moment, de l'antimatière a été dérobée au CERN. Robert Langdon, célèbre théologien de Harvard, est appelé à la rescousse par le Vatican afin de venir en aide à la police. En effet, l'enquête relative à la disparition récente de quatre cardinaux piétine. Langdon fait alors la connaissance de Vittoria Vetra, une scientifique qui travaille sur l'antimatière. Ensemble, ils mènent leur propre enquête. Ils apprennent que les cardinaux figuraient parmi les «preferiti». L'un deux était même un sérieux candidat au pontificat. Tous les indices conduisent vers la piste des «Illuminati», une confrérie secrète ayant pour but la perte de l'Eglise catholique...

programme.title: Hollywood Homicide
programme.desc: Joe Gavilan (Harrison Ford) et K.C. Calden (Josh Hartnett) sont tous deux inspecteurs à la brigade criminelle de Los Angeles. Joe arrondit ses fins de mois comme agent immobilier. On lui impose comme partenaire le jeune agent K.C. qui se fait également quelques à-côtés en donnant des cours de yoga. Suite à une étrange affaire de meurtre dans le milieu du rap, Joe et K.C. sont chargés de l'enquête et se voient contraints de collaborer en dépit de leurs personnalités diamétralement opposées... © 2003 Revolution Studios Distribution Company, LLC All Rights Reserved.

programme.title: Anacondas - À la poursuite de l'orchidée de sang
programme.desc: Un groupe de scientifiques décide de s'embarquer dans un voyage périlleux à la recherche d'une orchidée très rare qui pourrait détenir un sérum pour préserver la jeunesse. Mais l'expédition s'avère bien plus périlleuse que prévue. De redoutables prédateurs protègent l'orchidée et son terrible secret.

programme.title: Loverboy
programme.desc: Devenue mère, une femme délaissée par ses parents étant jeune en arrive à trop couver son fils de sept ans. Sa rencontre avec un homme va changer la vie du jeune garçon, qui voit en cet étranger une figure paternelle…

programme.title: Punch-drunk love - Ivre d'amour
programme.desc: Lauréate de la récompense du Meilleur réalisateur du Festival de Cannes 2002, 'cette histoire d'amour marginale entre des gens déconnectés essayant de se comprendre dans un monde antagoniste est une comédie de gène et de rage qui se transforment soudainement en sentiments purs et doux.' Adam Sandler interprète de façon assez inhabituelle et remarquable le rôle de Barry Egan, le propriétaire d'un magasin de babioles, handicapé social, dominé par ses sept sœurs et qui ne trouvera sans doute pas l'amour de lui-même. Lorsqu'une mystérieuse femme apparait dans sa vie, ses émotions s'affolent, passant d'une colère incontrôlable, à la luxure, au doute de soi. 'Punch-Drunk Love vous laisse confus, avec la tête qui tourne et surmonté par une plaisante sensation déplaisante.' 'Une comédie romantique aussi magnifique qu'étrange qui élargit les limites du genre de façon assez absurde et nous fait croire.' Du réalisateur/scénariste de Boogie Nights et de Magnolia, Punch-Drunk Love est un film sombre, unique et charmant.

programme.title: Julie & Julia
programme.desc: En 1948, Paul Child, fonctionnaire américain, arrive à Paris avec son épouse, Julia. Cherchant une occupation dans la capitale française, celle-ci s'inscrit à des cours de cuisine et prend goût à concocter des plats pour son époux et leurs amis. de cette expérience naît un livre de recettes qui rencontre un immense succès. de nos jours, Julie Powell, employée trentenaire de New York, a l'impression de tourner en rond. Son métier l'ennuie et elle jalouse la réussite de ses amies. Pour se divertir, et sur le conseil de son mari Eric, elle décide de lancer un blog culinaire. Elle se donne 365 jours pour réaliser toutes les recettes de Julia Child...

programme.title: Ricki And The Flash
programme.desc: Une Meryl Streep comme vous ne l'aviez jamais vue, en chanteuse-guitariste qui déchire, dans Ricki and the Flash, réalisé par Jonathan Demme, récompensé par un Oscar, avec un scénario de Diablo Cody, récompensé par un Academy Award. Dans un film original et électrisant, plein de performances musicales, Streep joue Ricki Rendazzo, une guitariste qui a fait énormément d'erreurs alors qu'elle voulait poursuivre son rêve dans le monde du rock 'n' roll. De retour chez elle, Ricki essaie de se faire pardonner et d'arranger les choses alors qu'elle fait face à la musique avec sa famille.

programme.title: Prof Poids Lourd
programme.desc: Ancien catcheur, Scott Voss est, à 42 ans, prof de biologie au collège. Lorsque des coupes budgétaires menacent d'annuler les cours de musique et de renvoyer le prof, Scott décide de rassembler des fonds en participant au noir à des combats d'arts martiaux. Tout le monde le prend d'abord pour un dingue - particulièrement Bella, l'infirmière de l'école - mais finalement, c'est auprès de toute l'école qu'il fait sensation…

programme.title: Ecole Paternelle
programme.desc: DADDY DAY CARE est une comédie hilarante sur des enfants contrôlant leur nid ! Lorsque les publicitaires Charlie (Eddie Murphy, Dr. Dolittle) et Phil (Jeff Garlin, émission TV 'Curb Your Enthusiasm') perdent leurs emplois en essayant de vendre des céréales de petit-déjeuner au goût de légumes, leurs femmes partent travailler. Mais lorsqu'ils réalisent qu'ils n'ont pas les moyens de maintenir leurs enfants à la très chic Académie Chapman dirigée par la vilaine Miss Harridan (Anjelica Huston, The Addams Family), Charlie et Phil deviennent propriétaires de 'Daddy Day Care'. Ces deux Messieurs Maman ne réalisent pas encore qu'ils viennent tout juste de commencer leurs aventures en babysitting ! L'excellent casting de DADDY DAY CARE inclut aussi Steve Zahn (Stuart Little), Regina King (Legally Blonde 2: Red, White and Blonde) et Kevin Nealon (Anger Management).

programme.title: Pixels
programme.desc: Lorsque des extraterrestres débarquent sur notre planète et prennent la forme de PAC MAN, Donkey Kong, Galaga, Centipede et Space Invaders pour nous attaquer, le président Will Cooper (Kevin James) doit faire appel à une équipe un peu particulière pour nous sauver. Sam (Adam Sandler), Ludlow (Josh Gad) et Eddie (Peter Dinklage), experts en jeux d'arcades dans les années 80, vont devoir ensemble faire face à leurs personnages préférés pour sauver la Terre, en comptant sur leur expertise, et sur des armes uniques

programme.title: The Man From Toronto
programme.desc: Teddy Jackson (Kevin Hart) est un entrepreneur empoté qui n'arrive à convaincre personne de financer ses idées. En emmenant sa femme en vacances, Teddy se retrouve dans le mauvais Airbnb et est confondu avec un redoutable tueur connu sous le nom de « l'homme de Toronto ». Lorsque le véritable assassin (Woody Harrelson) arrive, les deux se rendent compte qu'ils vont devoir travailler ensemble pour échapper aux agents tenaces du FBI, aux tueurs à gages assoiffés de sang et à leur commanditaire (Ellen Barkin) qui veut récupérer son argent. THE MAN frOM TORONTO est une comédie explosive qui déborde de scènes d'action.

programme.title: Big Daddy
programme.desc: Pour impressionner sa petite amie Vanessa et a la suite d'un quiproquo, Sonny, celibataire endurci, fait croire qu'il est le pere naturel de Julian, un jeune garcon de cinq ans qu'il adopte. C'est la catastrophe et l'enfer des nuits detruites, des seances insupportables de calins sans parler de la chanson du Kangourou, qui font decouvrir a Sony un monde qu'il ignorait totalement.

programme.title: L'interview Qui Tue
programme.desc: Dave Skylark, anime le talk-show 'Skylark Tonight', au cours duquel il interviewe des célébrités sur des sujets intimes. Alors que Dave et son équipe fêtent leur 1000e épisode, ils découvrent que le dirigeant nord-coréen Kim Jong-un est un fan de leur émission, ce qui incite le producteur du spectacle Aaron Rapoport à lui proposer une interview. Cependant l'agent de la CIA Lacey propose à Dave et Aaron d'assassiner Kim pour faciliter un coup d'État. Ces derniers acceptent à contrecœur. Arrivés en Corée du Nord, ils s'apercevront que tout ne se passera pas aussi bien que prévu.

programme.title: Sony One | Séries Comédie
programme.desc: Séries de comédies à mourir de rire pour une expérience relax et enjouée parfaite à partager en famille et avec des amis.

programme.title: Love’s Portrait
programme.desc: Lily, a museum curator, discovers a painting that looks just like her and is sent to find where the painting came from and who painted it. She tracks the painting down to the post office it was sent from in Ireland. There she meets William and Saoirse, a brother-sister duo who run the post, and who offer her help and friendship on her quest. But William knows more than he's letting on. Will he reveal what he knows if it risks his growing relationship--and mutual love--with Lily?

programme.title: My Perfect Romance
programme.desc: Robinson Tech is launching a new dating service that they ensure will find your Perfect Match. But when its's CEO and tech developer are challenged on Live TV to test the service themselves, the algorithm shows some interesting results.

programme.desc: Ivy is a romance book editor, up for a promotion at work but tasked with helping a stubborn mystery writer incorporate romance successfully into the next book in his series. He volunteers to be Ivy’s faux date for her best friend’s beach wedding in return for Ivy’s editing skills.

programme.desc: When Riley's boyfriend, Mandla, invites her to South Africa to meet his family, she is shocked to discover that he is a prince. The news puts Riley's trust in Mandla in jeopardy, and he must do what he can to win her love back.

programme.desc: Addison gets roped into traveling overseas with her brother and his picky billionaire boss. But clashing with the billionaire is no vacation, until he starts to have a change of heart.

programme.title: Austentatious
programme.desc: Lizzie gets excited when she lands a new real estate client, but it ends up being Collin, who isn't as subtle with his interest as he thinks. Elinor unexpectedly gets a promotion, but before she can celebrate, she learns that the promotion makes her the one to deal with the IRS when her employer’s company comes under investigation. The IRS agent she deals with is Edward Ferrars, and a pleasant surprise from the typical IRS agent she expected. Emma and her coworker Mr. Darcy have to work on a case together. Emma finds her legal methods are different from Darcy’s, and frustration ensues until both can stop to understand the other’s perspective.

programme.title: What's In the Barn?
programme.desc: “12hrs. & Running”: Dale turns a surprise 60th birthday party into a challenge to his guests to start 120 of the rarest motorcycles in the world.

programme.title: Cafe Racer
programme.desc: The history and development of the café racer is explored; included are exclusive interviews with Rockers from England and custom motorcycle builders.

programme.title: Cafe Racer
programme.desc: Dime City Cycles looks for a low buck, high yield Honda; Mods and Rockers square off in Dallas; Brian Richardson’s electric Manx Norton, and singer Billy Joel’s designs to keep the classic British café racer alive.

programme.title: Cafe Racer
programme.desc: J&B Customs leap before they look at improving an old Yamaha; Dime City attempt to turn trash into treasure; visit a reborn Norton motorcycle factory in England, and a country lawyer and his electric bike take on the big boys.

programme.title: Cafe Racer
programme.desc: A Harley mechanic tries his hand at building a café bike; stress levels rise as J&B look to make a technological leap; a former outlaw motorcycle stunt rider learns to race and build a café racer, and Dime City puts its 450 Honda in the hands of one of Florida’s fastest.

programme.title: Cafe Racer
programme.desc: The Garage Company showcase their parts in joining a Triumph and Rickman; Jay LaRossa shapes up a Yamaha single; Café ala Carte has Britain’s best bikes, and an original Rocker weighs in on Greg Hageman’s reborn Honda.

programme.title: Cafe Racer
programme.desc: Alan Bernard of Florida’s Santiago Choppers builds a Martin/Kawasaki custom; the Garage Company continue work on their Rickman; a visit with London’s Lewis Leathers, the world’s oldest motorcycle gear manufacturer, and the Bostrom brothers shake down a Yamaha single in the hills of Malibu.

programme.title: What's In the Barn?
programme.desc: An family farm in the mid-west contains houses, barns, outbuildings, trailers, grain silos and buses full of old stuff and perhaps the biggest stash of undiscovered old motorcycles in the country. The collection was put together by their unnamed father. Seller agrees to have Dale broker rare Excelsior for high-end client. Dale has the buyer, but will he outbid his own client for the exclusive find?

programme.title: What's In the Barn?
programme.desc: Matt is out for revenge. Last year Dale beat him badly at the Annual Vintage bike race in Barber, Alabama. But this year there is a whole new tale to tell. With just days until the race - Dale is secretly struggling to get the bike he beat Matt with last year up and working. Matt struggles just to locate a 100-year old bike. Matt's prayers are answered thanks to an old Catholic Priest he located who has possession of a bike. The priest might let Matt have the bike to race - but there are conditions. The toughest one: Don't tell Dale you have it. Can Matt afford to buy the bike and get it running in time for the race without Dale seeing it? Will Dale even get his broken bike started? And if they ever get to race, will Matt exact his revenge?

programme.title: What's In the Barn?
programme.desc: Built in the mid-60’s by eccentric engineer “Wild Bill” Gelbke, the Road Dog was, and still is, the largest motorcycle ever built. It utilized aircraft tubing, Corvette disc brakes, and a Chevy truck differential to keep it stable. The one-off creation disappeared when Gelbke did in 1978. Outflanked once when the bike was spotted and sold to a private collector in 1995, Dale has vowed to locate the machine and make Wheels Through Time its final resting place.

programme.title: What's In the Barn?
programme.desc: Big Time Motorcycle Auction

programme.title: What's In the Barn?
programme.desc: The RM Auction Company has worked with Dale before as a buyer, seller, historian, and caretaker at the prestigious Lee Hartung auction. But this event is no last minute rush to define one man’s treasures. This is a well calculated, time consuming, multi-media, and multi motorcycle and prized art deal.

programme.title: What's In the Barn?
programme.desc: Home Depot Senior Vice President, Gordon Erickson, is a huge fan of Wheels Through Time. He is also a huge supporter of the Wounded Warrior program. For years the hardware giant has been donating goods and services to help returning servicemen with their fix-it-up projects. Now they would like to go one step further and build a WWII military bike to raise awareness and funds. Only problem is where to get one? Enter Dale and an exhaustive, time sensitive, cross country search for a rare military machine.

programme.title: What's In the Barn?
programme.desc: Promoters of the prestigious Amelia Island Concours have called on Dale to develop a show and field bikes for an “Orphan Bike” show. They have defined orphan bike as extremely rare, that aren't a Harley nor Indian machines.

programme.title: What's In the Barn?
programme.sub-title: Time is Not On Their Side
programme.desc: For Dale and Matt sometimes the dotted line to treasure splits and heads in opposite directions. In this edition of What’s in the Barn, time is thrust to the forefront of this multi-state, long distance, north, south search. Timeless and priceless 110 year old bikes, antique cars, airplanes, and the infamous Egberts 1930 neon Harley-Davidson sign that coined the phrase “Ride a Winner” are high on this father and son’s list of “must haves”. The clock ticks, both literally and figuratively, on one rare time piece and two old-timer’s cars, bikes, and automobiles.

programme.title: Rutter's Detailin Garage
programme.desc: Nick Rutter provides valuable tips and techniques for how to detail various aspects of a motorcoach, including wheels and tires, granite care, proper leather care, as well as glass cleaning.

programme.title: Rutter's Detailin Garage
programme.desc: Nick Rutter showcases the products and process to properly wash your vehicle, from start to finish, starting with the wheels and tires and finishing with cleaning door jambs.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: In the 1960s, Smokey Yunick, the most innovative mechanic in NASCAR history, sold his famous truck that hauled equipment & cars across the country. Ray is on a mission to uncover this storied truck that helped launch the beginning of NASCAR’s cross-country popularity.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: Ray travels to Long Island, New York with the hopes of learning more about America’s first major auto racing competition. The race, which began at the turn of the 20th century, helped develop the first major American racing stars and drove American manufacturing to competitive standard with the highly progressive Europeans.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: Fred Dmuchowski is a New Jersey racing icon. He was a regular workingman who raced on weekends for fun and became a legend in his iconic 303 racer. Ray works to rebuild the 303 in homage to Fred who inspired him to pursue his career in motorsports.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: For Rick Hendrick, the Corvette inspired his first car purchase, which ultimately led to the creation of his car dealership empire and motorsports teams. Mr. H, as he goes by, gives us a rare look inside of his personal Corvette collection and takes us to General Motors World Headquarters to talk with GM Vice President of Global Design, Ed Welburn, about how this iconic car came about. Country superstar Brad Paisley makes a cameo appearance to talk about his prized ‘Vette and the influence of cars on his music.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: The last car Elvis drove the evening he passed was his beloved Stutz Blackhawk. Ray discovers that the car has been preserved and heads to Graceland to check out this iconic piece of American music history. Ray and the team reveal the impeccable preservation of the car at Charlotte Motor Speedway with Rick Hendrick (“Mr. H”) and, arguably Elvis Presley’s biggest fan, Dale Earnhardt Jr. While at Graceland, Ray and the team also get an exclusive look at the paneled station wagon Elvis used to get in and out of Graceland in disguise. It’s an intimate look at the King’s incredible automobiles and their secrets that only Elvis knew.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: This episode takes an inside look at the famous racing L88 Corvette. From its history, to its successes and heartbreaks, to the stories of the men that drove it. Now, it’s a car world’s version of the Flinstones meet the Jetsons, as the Owens Corning Corvette, which clinched 22 straight race victories, challenges the new Corvette C7-R at Sebring International Raceway. The original Owens Corning team reunites for the challenge and our crew goes behind the scenes for the Corvette test drive of a lifetime.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Caffeine & Octane is back at the beach on Jekyll Island with a focus on cars and families. Fathers & sons, with their barn-find Pilot House trucks and Plymouth Satellites, call cars the glue that keeps them bonded together with C&O being the best place to show them off.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: On this edition of Caffeine & Octane, we’ll go inside the head of Master Builder Bryan Fuller at the SEMA car show, the largest annual trade show in the country; SEMA always brings out the best in the automotive industry. From a jaw dropping Javelin to a multimillion-dollar Pagani, Brian will prove to you, what happens in Vegas, doesn’t always stay in Vegas! Ryan Hardwick guest hosts and ventures deep into the C&O lots to find his favorite ride of the day.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Take apart and assemble a motor in less than 30 minutes? Host Rickey Gadson heads to the Sims Academy to settle a bet. This ultra fast half-hour edition of Caffeine & Octane also includes a builder’s take on an Ultra Four Unlimited Off-Road Racer; Ryan Hardwick joins the gang at Caffeine and Octane.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Demetrio Montalvo likes American music, American food, and especially American cars. Only one problem - Demetrio lives in Cuba. A Visa, bestowed to him from some American friends in high places, lets him travel to the States to search for tough to find automotive parts and attend his favorite car show. Showing up to Caffeine & Octane in a cool caddy is the easy part. Picking parts to take back home presents a unique set of challenges for the Cuban car builder; Formula Drift racer Federico Sceriffo brings the first ever Formula Drift Ferrari to C&O.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Porsche collector, customizer, and Urban Outlaw, Magnus Walker is a world-wide rock star to fans of the German car company. programme.title: THE WAWIES
programme.desc: Wawaland is a tiny world within planet Earth. So small and light that it gets carried away by the wind. Right now, it could be flying over Tokyo, Paris, or the Atlantic Ocean, completely unseen by humans. In this magical place live The Wawies—chubby and curious beings who are always asking questions and trying to make sense of the world around them and ours. Through Sha’s far-away glasses, the Wawies can observe how humans behave on Earth and apply what they learn in their own world, sparking endless adventures that teach them, entertain them, help them explore their surroundings, and listen to themselves. They always stick together and never leave anyone behind. For example, this season, you might find them competing in their own version of Wawachef,” escaping from some not-so-friendly monkeys, deciding to ban rules in their world forever, trying to calm down some feisty ants, training their patience to care for a garden, or figuring out which costume party is more fun: Halloween or Carnival. With each adventure, Sha, Opo, Aca, Bow, and Tok strive to understand, grow, and have fun. And along the way, they’ll unintentionally create their own set of rules to live in a place where respect and harmony with their surroundings are key. With its playful and cheerful tone, Wawaland seeks to show children a different way of seeing things—helping them appreciate the world around them and, most importantly, themselves.

programme.title: Dirt
programme.sub-title: DIRT - "Big Waves, Wild Foraging and the Fight to Preserve Hawaiian Culture"
programme.desc: The best way to learn is by doing, especially in Hawaiʻi. Teaming up with locals like Chef Mark "Gooch" Noguchi, Nathan Florence, and Jack Johnson, the DIRT crew dove headfirst into the rugged microclimates and deep-rooted cultures that define the islands. Charging waves, tracking invasive Axis deer, and diving for dinner gave Josh and the gang a visceral education in what makes this archipelago so singular. The hard work and good times culminated in a final feast as complex and generous as Hawaiʻi itself.

programme.title: Hard Truths of Conservation

After a few months of research and talking with the experts at Worldwide Trophy Adventures, he laid out the plan to attempt the South America slam in 2022. programme.title: Wild Ones - S01:E07 - Wild Australia
programme.desc: More than 80 percent of Australia’s plants, mammals, reptiles and frogs are unique to Australia and are found nowhere else in the world. Wild dingos, frisky kangaroos, deceptively cuddly looking koalas and playful platypuses are some of the most iconic of Australia’s wild animals.

programme.title: Wild Ones - S01:E08 - Masters of the Sky
programme.desc: So many words describe the many ways that birds fly – pelicans and kestrels soar but owls fly silently. Parrots flock, vultures swarm and eagles swoop. Radar-accurate eyes scan the ground and slotted feathers adjust flight paths as hawks attack. But, which is the true master of the sky?

programme.title: Sasquatch Mountain Man - S01:E03 - Grizzly: Part 2
programme.desc: Laramy's hunt for the Grizzly, also known as the North American Brown Bear continues. Weighing in at an average of 130 - 180 kilos for a female and and between 180 to 360 kilos for a male the Grizzly is a worthy opponent.

programme.title: Sasquatch Mountain Man - S01:E04 - Colorado Lion
programme.desc: In Colorado, lions will generally be most abundant in areas with plentiful deer and individual lions range in areas varying in size from 10 to 370 square miles. Laramy will have his work cut out hunting them.

programme.title: Sasquatch Mountain Man - S01:E05 - Montana Whitetail
programme.desc: Laramy walks the snow-covered mountains of Montana in search of whitetail deer.

programme.title: Sasquatch Mountain Man - S01:E06- Nebraska Trapping
programme.desc: Laramy hunts beavers in Nebraska.

programme.title: Miracles of Nature - S01:E03 - Naturally Diverse
programme.desc: The episode focuses on the Arabian peninsula. The endless red desert in Oman contrasts with Yemen ́s island of Socotra. The endemic crabs from Socotra compete with sea turtles who gather on a single beach in Oman to lay their eggs. And, it is also claimed that the petrified rock formation is of Noah's Ark.

programme.title: Miracles of Nature - S01:E04 - Naturally Exotic
programme.desc: This Episode of Miracles of Nature takes you on a journey from the Antigua in the Caribbean to the favourite of climbers - the Blue Mountains of New South Wales, Australia and then back to the Caribbean to admore in the beauty of The British Virgin Islands with stunning white beaches and turquoise waters.

programme.title: Miracles of Nature - S01:E05 - Naturally Fierce
programme.desc: Visit the wintry North Pole from the comfort of your settee as this episode takes us on a journey to the icy Artic and then to Quebec to watch the most southernly fjord set at low tide, before journeying on to Alberta to take in the magnitude of the Sasquachuan River as it makes its way through the Rocky Mountains.

programme.title: Carter's W.A.R. - S02:E06 - On the Frontline
programme.desc: From rhino saviors and lion researchers, to savvy entrepreneurs and armed security teams, Ivan tours the front lines of conservation to meet the individuals who are reshaping and protecting wild Africa. What does it really mean to devote your life to the cause of conservation? Ivan journeys to four separate countries to find out what makes these unsung heroes tick.

programme.title: Wild Ones - S01:E05 - Strongest
programme.desc: How do you decide which is the strongest animal on the Planet? Wild Ones looks at the comparative strength of the tiniest of ants to that of a might grizzly bear, or a deadly crocodile to the indestructible rhinoceros.
